title: Peace comes by serving, not starring
summary: Serving the Guru brings peace and exposes the self to light. Treat ego as illness, not identity.
takeaway: Treat ego as illness, not identity.
lifeApplication: Before explaining yourself again, do the next act of obedience quietly. Let service bring light where self-display keeps asking for it.

source.shortMeaning: Serving the Guru brings peace and exposes the self to light.
source.lifeApplication: When ego reaches for the lead, answer first with service.
